command.sync: Open Missing Files from Default Profile
welcome.aiEdits:
Nothing yet. When an agent writes a file, it shows up here — opened, linted and waiting for your review.
[Install Agent Hooks](command:openfiles.installHooks)
[Add Uncommitted Git Changes](command:openfiles.scanGitChanges)
New here? [Open the walkthrough](command:openfiles.getStarted).
welcome.problems: No problems in AI-edited files. Either your agent is having a great day, or no linter is installed for these languages — [Run Doctor](command:openfiles.doctor) to check.
welcome.agents:
No agents detected in this workspace.
[Install Agent Hooks](command:openfiles.installHooks)
welcome.profiles:
Profiles open a fixed set of files with one click.
[Create .openfiles.json](command:openfiles.openConfig)
walkthrough.title: Get Started with OpenFiles
walkthrough.description: See and lint every file your AI agent touches, in about two minutes.
walkthrough.detect.title: Find the agents you use
walkthrough.detect.description:
OpenFiles looks for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenCode and others in this workspace.
[Run Doctor](command:openfiles.doctor)
walkthrough.mode.title: Decide what happens when an agent edits a file
walkthrough.mode.description:
Open the file in the background (default), only list it in the sidebar, or just notify you.
[Choose a mode](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22openfiles.mode%22%5D)
walkthrough.hooks.title: Connect your agent
walkthrough.hooks.description:
Hooks tell OpenFiles exactly which agent edited which file — and let your linters talk back to the agent. Nothing is written without a preview.
[Install Agent Hooks](command:openfiles.installHooks)
walkthrough.linters.title: Make sure a linter is watching
walkthrough.linters.description:
OpenFiles opens the files; your language extensions do the checking. Doctor lists the languages in this repo that have no linter installed.
[Check linters](command:openfiles.doctor)
walkthrough.prompt.title: Tell your agent about it
walkthrough.prompt.description:
Paste a short snippet into AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md so your agent reads the problems OpenFiles collects before it says it's done.
[Copy a prompt](command:openfiles.copyAgentPrompt)
walkthrough.star.title: That's it
walkthrough.star.description:
If OpenFiles catches something your agent missed, a star helps other people find it.
[Star on GitHub](https://github.com/devgiordane/openfiles)
config.mode: What to do when an agent edits a file.
config.mode.open: Open the file in a tab so language servers check it.
config.mode.queue: Only list it in the AI Edits view.
config.mode.notify: Show a notification with an Open button.
config.openInBackground: Open changed files without stealing focus from the terminal or the file you're in.
config.maxAutoOpen: Stop auto-opening after this many files in a session; the rest are listed in AI Edits. `0` never auto-opens.
config.closeReviewedTabs: Close a file's tab when you mark it as reviewed.
config.ignore: Glob patterns that are never tracked. `files.exclude` and `.gitignore` are respected too.
config.sensitive: Glob patterns that are tracked but never opened automatically (secrets, keys).
config.detection.watcher: Detect files changed on disk by anything other than this editor.
config.detection.git: Use the Git extension to find uncommitted changes and to ignore branch switches.
config.detection.hooks: Read edits reported by agent hooks (`.openfiles/queue.jsonl`).
config.detection.burstLimit: If more files than this change within 2 seconds (installs, builds, checkouts), list them instead of opening them.
config.detection.editorSaveGraceMs: Changes within this many milliseconds of a save in the editor are treated as yours, not the agent's.
config.diagnostics.export: Write problems for AI-edited files to `.openfiles/diagnostics.json` so agents can read them.
config.hooks.feedback: What agent hooks send back to the agent after an edit.
config.hooks.feedbackTimeoutMs: How long a hook waits for language servers before letting the agent continue.
config.statusBar.enabled: Show OpenFiles in the status bar.
config.statusBar.items: What the status bar item shows, in order.
config.statusBar.clickAction: What clicking the status bar item does.
config.statusBar.alignment: Which side of the status bar to use.
config.configFile: Workspace-relative path of the profiles file.
config.heartbeatSeconds: How often the list of open tabs is published to `.openfiles/vscode/` for agents and hooks.
color.unreviewed: Color of the AI badge on files that haven't been reviewed.
